# Terminal confirmation signature fixture

Created on source base 7199850fb0c7a8a6dc7a52ddba8b019b8092bb64 by `ssh-keygen -Y sign` with a disposable Ed25519 key.
The input is the terminal message for `engine_start`, arguments `{"root":"/selected"}`, Store `store`, and a 32-byte zero test value.
The private key is discarded.
